timing_semantics.first_call_ns: in-call wall clock for the first entry call in a newly loaded VM
timing_semantics.jit_compile_ns: in-process time spent in actual JIT compilation attempts during load and calls
timing_semantics.parse_compile_ns: in-process load_script wall clock, including eager JIT compilation
timing_semantics.process_wall_time_ns: process-inclusive runner wall clock: startup, file read, parsing, eager JIT compilation, all requested VM calls, and shutdown
timing_semantics.runtime_counts: per-thread runtime counter deltas across the requested calls in one child process
timing_semantics.warm_call_ns: per-call in-call wall clocks after the first call, reusing the same loaded VM
timing_semantics.warm_throughput_per_second: derived only from the completed warm_call_ns values when more than one in-process call was requested
timing_semantics.warmups: discarded fresh child processes; separate from warm calls that reuse a VM inside each child
